content:
Strategic Infrastructure Agreement Between Google and Apple

Apple has made a significant shift in its AI strategy by entering into a comprehensive partnership with Google. Under the terms of the agreement, Apple will leverage Google’s Gemini models and cloud infrastructure to support AI features on its devices, particularly Siri. In a joint statement issued by the two companies, it was noted that Google’s technology provides the most capable infrastructure for Apple’s core AI models.

Gemini 3 and Cloud Integration

Looking at the technical details, the integration centers on Google’s Gemini 3 model. Apple’s move indicates that the company will use a hybrid structure combining its own proprietary cloud infrastructure with Google’s server capacity. According to Bloomberg sources, the annual financial value of the agreement is approximately $1 billion. This partnership aims to address infrastructure shortcomings ahead of Apple’s major Siri update, which is reportedly postponed until 2026.

OpenAI Partnership Continues

This agreement with Google does not mean that Apple is ending its existing AI partnerships. The company will continue to use OpenAI and ChatGPT models for complex queries and certain features under Apple Intelligence. The Google integration is expected to optimize the balance between on-device and cloud-based processing.

  • Model: Google Gemini 3
  • Scope: Siri and core AI functions
  • Infrastructure: Google Cloud and Apple Private Cloud
  • Cost: Estimated at $1 billion annually
